name: thermal-ranking
description: Deterministic ranking of eight original synthetic heat-sink candidates. Not real engineering advice. Outputs JSON with source IDs and constraint decisions.

actions.name: rank_baseline
actions.description: Evaluate all eight candidates at the original 5 USD/kg ceiling and write ranking.json.

output_mount_configurations.output_description: Synthetic material ranking JSON from the actual tool run

actions.name: rank_cost_revision
actions.description: Re-evaluate with a hard cost ceiling of 3 USD/kg; retain the original score normalization.

output_mount_configurations.output_description: Revised synthetic ranking JSON from the actual tool run
